# London breakout notes

A tight overnight range followed by a London open expansion has been the most repeatable setup in the notes this quarter. The claim is that the expansion follows the range compression, not the news.

# Funding basis note

Perpetual funding turned negative while spot held, which the authors read as crowded shorts rather than a directional signal.
